the intracellular-activating promoter system is an efficient tool for the construction of recombinant Salmonella vaccines, which is more efficient than the traditional aroA carrier strain.
intracellular- activated promoters are more efficient than the constitutive promoters in the generation of live recombinant Salmonella vaccines.
